hypothesis: Direct pre-BN quaternion consumer-output regression can recover more classification quality than shared feature reconstruction followed by folding at exactly the same compact Q architecture, masks and real parameter count.
scope: Fixed replication/follow-up chosen after the positive CIFAR BN seed2026 f=.5 pilot. BN: CIFAR and EuroSAT, three EXISTING source seeds, f=.25/.5. Secondary: existing no-BN CIFAR seed2026 only, two fractions. Fourteen groups; reuse the discovery pilot without retraining, thirteen NEW three-epoch repairs. No new baselines, alpha/architecture search, classifier refit, test evaluation or automatic extension. Five Q consumers use the unchanged float64 ridge solver centered on the same local map-fold candidate; last real readout uses map-fold only. Same 500 fit/500 check split, same previous-study victims for every group. Regression uses no labels and leaves all other parameters/BN statistics unchanged; only later repair uses labels. References from the completed structural-cost study are reused. Primary before/after epoch-three accuracy/CE paired by source seed at fixed size. Full dense reference has a different parameter budget and is diagnostic, not an equal-size competitor.
interpretation_rules: Report CIFAR discovery seed2026 f=.5 separately from the two new-seed replications. Three-seed summaries include discovery and are not an independent confirmation. EuroSAT is new for this method but its data/test outcomes were used earlier; no fresh blind evaluation claim.
Keep all unfavorable effects and per-seed signs, means and sample SD. One-seed no-BN remains exploratory. No significance/equivalence claim from a small mean or n=3.

Objective, centered regularization and compensation parameterization differ from the old map-fold procedure together; this is not an isolated pure feasible-space effect, a new LS theorem or an irreducible Q architecture bound.

Do not tune alpha, masks or checkpoint selection on validation/check outcomes. Final third repair epoch stays the endpoint. Record successful steps for new repairs; old references have only attempted schedules audited.
Stop after these fixed jobs and assess repeatability/heterogeneity before planning another study. No automatic growth of the sweep or guaranteed novelty/acceptance.
